name: motif_add_environment
description:
Author an environment. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs or nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Use only if a form's occurrence depends on neighbouring sounds; otherwise use a stem name, inflection class or required features. Name natural classes, not sound lists; an environment that spells one whole word is a stem list (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages an environment with explicitly declared left and right contexts in a Draft. Contexts use project phonemes, natural classes or boundaries. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-environment. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id, exact name or abbreviation; names must resolve uniquely using NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming. The class must have a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

boundaryMarker.description: Stored boundary-marker id. Rule contexts preserve its literal identity, even when its code is #.

left.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.
